subject: Re: Novum Accelerator — request to aggregate cohort credits + packaging ask
messages:
From: Sophie Turner <sophie@novumaccelerator.org>
To: diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Novum Accelerator — cohort credits and packaging question

Hi Diego,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency and cost breakdown was really helpful. Two quick asks from our side as we finalize the cohort offer: we typically allocate a pool of vendor credits at the cohort level and then top up teams as needed. For Redwood, a couple of constraints came up in procurement:

- Can cohort credits be aggregated into a single program pool (one billing seat) rather than separate team-level grants?
- If we need to top up an individual team mid-cohort, can those top-ups be applied retroactively to usage in the same billing period?

We have attached the SOW and a CSV of expected consumption across the 12 teams (Novum_Program_SOW.pdf, credit_usage_snapshot.csv). Procurement will need a short note on how this will be invoiced and whether we can get a promo exception for an additional 10% onboarding credit (we run a promo for new cohorts).

Appreciate any guidance — procurement leadership is on the cc (procurement@novumaccelerator.org). Happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

Best,
Sophie Turner
Director, Partnerships
Novum Accelerator
From: diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com
To: Sophie Turner <sophie@novumaccelerator.org>
Cc: procurement@novumaccelerator.org
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Novum Accelerator — cohort credits and packaging question

Sophie — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. Short answers up front:

1) Aggregated cohort pool: yes, we can support a single program-level credit pool that invoices to the accelerator and allows admins to allocate to teams. We call this "program pooling" in our billing layer.
2) Retroactive top-ups: we can apply top-ups to cover past usage within the same billing cycle, but there are guardrails to prevent abuse (top-up approval flags and an audit trail).

A few follow-ups so I can give procurement a neat summary:
- Is Novum planning to pay centrally for the entire cohort or split billing with team reimbursements? (This affects invoicing lines and whether we create sub-accounts.)
- Do you need the 10% onboarding promo applied to the program pool or just to newly activated teams?
- Any SLA / dedicated capacity expectations for specific teams (some cohorts ask for occasional dedicated bursts).

Looping in Lauren Bishop (sales ops) and Ben Carter (partnerships) to confirm billing flow and whether we need a formal pricing exception approved by sales leadership. Monica from finance is in copy for invoicing implications.

Happy to draft a short scope note for procurement once I have answers — or we can do a 20-min call tomorrow.

— Diego
Director, Startup Programs, Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
To: diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com; ben_carter@redwoodinference.com; monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Novum Accelerator — cohort credits and packaging question

Diego / Ben / Monica — quick internal thread. Thoughts below.

Ben: for partner credit stacking we historically allow a single pool invoiced to the partner, with per-team allocation controls in the console. We mark those as "program" billing and they appear as one line item on the invoice. Works fine for finance, but needs procurement note that teams won't receive separate invoices unless Novum requests sub-accounting.

Monica: retroactive top-ups are permitted if requested within the billing period; finance needs a strong change log (who approved, amount, effective date). If procurement wants an exception for retroactive application beyond 30 days we'd need formal approval and likely a write-off policy.

Proposal: allow the 10% onboarding promo to be applied to the program pool for this cohort as a one-time exception if Novum signs a 3-month commit and gives a headcount estimate. That preserves our promo economics and gives Novum the uplift they want.

Action items:
- Ben to confirm partner promo exception authority (do we need CD-level signoff?)
- Monica to outline invoicing language for program pooling and audit log requirements
- Diego to draft a short procurement note and proposed DocuSign SOW change (I can attach redwood-proposal-draft.docx).

Lauren
Senior Sales Ops Manager
From: diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com
To: Sophie Turner <sophie@novumaccelerator.org>, procurement@novumaccelerator.org
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Novum Accelerator — cohort credits and packaging question

Sophie — thanks for your patience. Per internal review, here is the agreed path we can commit to for Novum's cohort:

1) Program pooling: Redwood will provision a single program credit pool billed to Novum Accelerator. The pool will be visible to Novum admins and Redwood will provide per-team allocation controls. Default behavior: Novum invoices one charge with line-item breakdown.

2) Onboarding promo: we can extend a one-time 10% onboarding credit applied to the program pool if Novum signs the attached SOW addendum and commits to a 3-month minimum cohort period (this is our standard safeguard for promo exceptions).

3) Retroactive top-ups: we will allow top-ups to cover past usage within the same billing cycle. Any retroactive requests older than 30 days require manual review and written approval; those are handled as pricing exceptions and may require a small administration fee. All top-ups will create an audit entry showing approver, amount, and effective date.

4) Dedicated bursts: if any team requests dedicated capacity for demo day, we can route them to Dedicated capacity for scheduled windows; separate SOW line-items and pricing apply.

Next steps:
- Sophie / procurement: confirm whether Novum wants central billing only or needs sub-account invoices per team.
- If central billing: sign the SOW addendum (redwood-proposal-draft.docx) and we'll apply the 10% credit on invoice issuance.

I've attached a short procurement note and the draft SOW addendum for your legal team to review. Let me know if you'd like a 20-min call to finalize.

Best,
Diego
Director, Startup Programs
Redwood Inference
